targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  event_date AS time,
  app_info_id,
  count() AS event_count
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = '${event_name}'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
  AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
GROUP BY event_date, app_info_id
ORDER BY event_date

SELECT
  event_date AS time,
  app_info_id,
  uniqExact(user_pseudo_id) AS unique_users
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = '${event_name}'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
  AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
GROUP BY event_date, app_info_id
ORDER BY event_date

SELECT
  param_screen_class AS screen,
  count() AS event_count,
  uniqExact(user_pseudo_id) AS unique_users
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = '${event_name}'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
  AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
  AND param_screen_class IS NOT NULL AND param_screen_class != ''
GROUP BY param_screen_class
ORDER BY event_count DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT
  concat(device_mobile_brand_name, ' ', device_mobile_model_name) AS device,
  count() AS event_count
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = '${event_name}'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
  AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
  AND device_mobile_brand_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY device
ORDER BY event_count DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT
  concat(device_operating_system, ' ', device_operating_system_version) AS os_version,
  count() AS event_count
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = '${event_name}'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
  AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
  AND device_operating_system IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY os_version
ORDER BY event_count DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT
  param_engagement_time_msec / 1000 AS engagement_seconds
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = '${event_name}'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
  AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
  AND param_engagement_time_msec IS NOT NULL
  AND param_engagement_time_msec > 0
  AND param_engagement_time_msec < 600000
